function_spec.name: H6 Funding × Vol × Market-Regime
function_spec.data_source: Binance BTCUSDT spot close + USDT-perp daily mean funding bps
function_spec.entry_condition: vol_regime == 'medium' AND funding_regime == 'low' AND market_regime not in {'bear', 'unknown'}
function_spec.exit_rule: scheduled at entry + 7 calendar days; no intra-hold exits in Phase E demo

regime_definitions.vol_regime: RV21 annualized (std of log-returns × √365); trailing 252d tercile. low < 33th pctile; high > 67th pctile.
regime_definitions.funding_regime: Binance USDT-perp daily mean funding rate × 10000 (bps); trailing 252d tercile, same boundaries.
regime_definitions.market_regime: SMA200 + 20d slope. bull = close > rising SMA200; bear = close < falling SMA200; else sideways. unknown until 220d history.

function_spec.lockbox_status: spent in D.5 (2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31); never reused

evidence_basis.lockbox_verdict: REJECT BOTH (regime absent in -30.3% bear year)

promotion_criteria.description: Criteria to promote H6 from demo evidence to production consideration. All gates must pass simultaneously. Evaluated only after minimum sample reached.

G1_direction.description: Mean trade return > 0 (net of 15 bps cost)

G2_power.description: t-test one-sided p < 0.10 (n=30 gives ~40% power at true SR=0.37/trade)

G3_regime_presence.description: At least 15 signal-days in non-bear conditions (regime not absent)

G5_regime_stability.description: Regimes stable (vol, funding, market) for ≥ 80% of hold days

promotion_criteria.notes: n=30 is underpowered (power ~40% at per-trade SR=0.37). Failure to reject H0 at p<0.10 is NOT proof of no edge; record as 'insufficient evidence' not 'disproven'.

daily_job.trigger: once per day, after daily close is available (00:05 UTC)
data_inputs: Binance BTCUSDT spot close (from 1m OHLCV, last bar of day)
Binance USDT-perp daily mean funding rate
StrataTrade funding bps (if API accessible; optional)
